meta.source: NISR Agricultural Household Survey (AHS) 2024 microdata, plot-level crop, input and practice records
meta.method: Survey-weighted medians; per-crop log-yield regression with bootstrap intervals
meta.caveat: Associations from survey data, not guarantees. Yields are farmer-reported harvest per hectare of crop area on sampled plots and differ from NISR's official published national totals. Confirm inputs with RAB or your district agronomist.
